STEP 1 - Scene: A salad bowl with sliced steak (medium-rare, quinoa-crusted), cubed tofu, broccoli florets and a base of lettuce/leafy greens.

STEP 2 - Vessel: A white bowl, roughly 22 cm diameter (looks between a side plate and dinner plate, so I estimate ~22 cm). Area = 3.14 x (11)^2 ≈ 380 cm^2. Food fills most of the bowl.

- Lettuce / leafy greens (base)
- Sliced steak with quinoa crust
- Broccoli florets
- Cubed tofu (pan-seared, pale)

- Steak: 20% (76 cm^2)
- Broccoli: 17% (65 cm^2)
- Tofu: 13% (49 cm^2)

- Greens: 133 cm^2 x 2.5 cm ≈ 333 ml
- Steak: 76 cm^2 x 1.5 cm ≈ 114 ml
- Broccoli: 65 cm^2 x 2.5 cm ≈ 163 ml
- Tofu: 49 cm^2 x 1.5 cm ≈ 74 ml

STEP 6 - Grams:

- Tofu: 74 x 0.9 ≈ 67 g

STEP 7 - Energy (as plated):
- Greens: 50 g x 15 kcal/100g ≈ 8 kcal
- Steak (cooked, lean-medium): 108 g x 220 kcal/100g ≈ 238 kcal (includes quinoa crust, so modest uplift)
- Broccoli: 90 g x 34 kcal/100g ≈ 31 kcal
- Tofu (firm, pan-fried): 67 g x 145 kcal/100g ≈ 97 kcal

Total ≈ 305 g, ≈ 374 kcal.

STEP 8 - Sanity check: A bowl mostly full of greens, meat, broccoli and tofu at about 300 g and roughly 370 kcal is plausible for a moderate main-course salad with no visible dressing or oil pool. Dressing is not clearly visible, so none is added.
